compatibilityPolicy.breakingChangeRule: Publish a new major contract version and retain the previous schema for historical validation.
compatibilityPolicy.enumExpansionRule: Treat enum expansion as breaking for strict consumers; publish a new major contract version.
compatibilityPolicy.additionalPropertiesRule: Schemas currently using additionalProperties=false reject unknown fields. Additive fields are not assumed backward-compatible; validate against an explicitly selected contract version.
compatibilityPolicy.migrationRule: No implicit migration. Every migration must identify source and target versions, be deterministic, preserve evidence provenance, and include round-trip or documented-loss tests.
compatibilityPolicy.unknownVersionRule: Reject unknown contract versions; never silently coerce to the latest schema.

contracts.name: evidence-record
contracts.notes: Version is carried by schema identity; record shape itself has no schemaVersion field.

contracts.name: assessment-report
contracts.notes: Contains nested evidence metadata; its observationClass must remain aligned with evidence-record v1.

contracts.name: geo-observation
contracts.notes: GEO observationClass is a strict subset of evidence-record v1.

contracts.name: evidence-ledger-entry
contracts.notes: Append-only logical ledger entry; local store limitations are documented separately.

contracts.name: evidence-ledger-checkpoint
contracts.notes: Detached Ed25519 checkpoint; signature trust depends on out-of-band public-key custody.

contracts.name: mcp-snapshot
contracts.notes: Caller-supplied normalized MCP metadata snapshot; no network connection or tool invocation.
